chapter: Rhythm and the Sam Morgan band
title: Joining Isaiah and Sam Morgan's band, 1920-22
summary: He joined Isaiah Morgan's band in 1920, soon after France; the band split when Sam had a stroke, and was later put under Sam's name.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When did you join Sam Morgan? That was your first job, you said, I believe.
I got in Sam's band in 1922. 22.

Sam. No, the first band, his brother Isaiah Morgan, but Sam, Sam here, his band, his band, the Magnolia band, he had, well, they had a split, you see. Sam had a stroke and he got sick, well, the band split, you see. And after Sam got out, got well, well, he come with his brother and put the band on the Sam name because he had all the work and everything, you know. He's more famous. Put everything in his hand.
So now you joined Isaiah first.
1920. You'd just gotten back from France, I guess, a little while ago.
Oh, yeah, I just got from the old sea.
